howToPlay: Control the battlefield by throwing ticket bundles over obstacles to apply double-hit damage. Call Lawrie to provide fire support and use the Order Swap or Order Fall Back gadgets to reposition or heal. Coordinate with Lawrie to distribute incoming damage using Protocol Protect or maintain constant pressure with Protocol Assist.
gears: Pick Speed and Health for better mobility and survivability. Damage and Shield are excellent choices to bolster your offensive pressure and durability during close encounters.
trait: Larry & Lawrie suits players who enjoy tactical zone control and managing a duo to overwhelm opponents.
